description.short: Celtic Quest Coasteering is a Pembrokeshire-based adventure operator specialising in guided coasteering sessions along the Abereiddy Bay shoreline and Blue Lagoon. Founded in 2008, they offer family, adult, corporate, and accessible sessions involving cliff jumping, cave exploration, adventure swimming, and sea-level traversing — all equipment provided. Fully AALA-licensed and a member of the National Coasteering Charter.

description.full:
Celtic Quest Coasteering is one of Wales's most established coasteering operators, based at Abereiddy Bay in the Pembrokeshire Coast National Park. Founded in 2008, the company set out to make coasteering accessible to everyday people — not just extreme sports enthusiasts — and has since developed a reputation as a premier guide service on this stretch of the South Pembrokeshire coast.

The company's home base is Abereiddy Beach (SA62 6DT), where activities centre on the famous Blue Lagoon: a flooded Victorian slate quarry connected to the sea, and one of the birthplaces of commercial coasteering in Wales in the 1980s. The Blue Lagoon has also hosted the Red Bull Cliff Diving World Series in 2012, 2013, and 2016.

Guided sessions last approximately 2 hours and include sea-level traversing, cliff jumping, adventure swimming, wave dodging, sea cave exploration, and — for those seeking a seal encounter — swimming alongside the Atlantic grey seals that frequent the bay. Wetsuits, helmets, buoyancy aids, wetsuit socks, hood, and gloves are all supplied. Sessions run twice daily across two seasonal time-slots: 9:30 am and 1:30 pm from March to October, and 11 am and 1 pm from November to February.

The minimum age for standard public sessions is 8 years (children from 5 may attend by arrangement). Adult, family, children's, corporate, and disabled-accessible sessions are all available. Celtic Quest is fully licensed by the Adventure Activities Licensing Authority (AALA) and is a member of both the National Coasteering Charter and the Pembrokeshire Outdoor Charter Group. Public liability insurance cover is £10 million.

The company has won Best Visitor Experience in Wales at the National Tourism Awards (2013) and holds the TripAdvisor Travellers' Choice Award (2025).
